name: Graviton 引力子
detailed_description:
A 2D platform puzzle game based on gravity control, rigorous yet full of surprises, reveals the laws governing the operation of the world under the existence of non-existent physical laws, and enables you to understand everything that happens in the place you are in during the journey.

Currently included mechanisms:

1. Anti-gravity: Completely freely control the direction of gravity (up or down), which also affects the behavior of all objects in space. Utilize this point and combine with your physical intuition to cross obstacles.

2. Anti-matter: Anti-matter is subject to gravity opposite to that of positive matter. Under the premise of gravity manipulation, there are more variations, and physical phenomena that do not exist in reality emerge (only experienced in the demo version).

3. Magnetic field: Can pull metal objects to move. The combination of magnetic force and gravity makes the levels more diverse.

4. Gravity field: You will automatically switch gravity within the field, but you cannot freely switch gravity; the limitation of basic abilities will force you to plan your action scheme before entering the field.

5. The Mirror: Cooperate with the mirror-like form of yourself. He will imitate your behavior, but due to terrain limitations, there will be different degrees of asynchrony. Utilize this to cross obstacles that cannot be crossed by yourself alone.

... More mechanisms are under development and this description will be gradually improved as it is updated.
